lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sm₂Mg₈Cu₂ (SmMg₄Cu) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Cu and Sm centers each have 12 geometric neighbors (8 Mg plus 4 of the other element, at 3.09–3.28 Å), while Mg centers have 12 neighbors (4 Cu, 4 Mg, and 4 Sm). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra with corner, edge, and face sharing, and Cu–Sm polyhedra with corner and edge sharing.
